detail.longDescription: Every labor-saving device ever invented came with the same promise and the same catch. The robot vacuum, for example, will clean your floors while you relax, and it does—right after you spend 15 minutes moving chair legs and coiling phone chargers so it doesn't eat them. The work didn't disappear. It changed shape and moved upstream. AI coding tools do the same thing.
